message:
feat(apk, keepalive-r2 ② e): the standby JNI -- the app's StandbyRunner, its device-id file, an asynchronous capability

nativeStandbyInit(filesDir) makes the runner with FileGenerationStore (files dir, standby_generation.bin) and
/dev/urandom device ids; nativeStandbyStart / Status ([exists, state, lost, handedOff, needsCapability]) / Observe
(from that PC's lease socket, blocking ~2 s -- off the UI thread) / Provide (the token and where to aim, from Kotlin's
standby connect) / Release / ReleaseAll. The lease has no capability source of its own on Android (the directory
HTTP is Kotlin's): it says it needs one.
Shipping: nothing calls these -- Preconnect.SEND_TO_REAL_HOSTS stays false; the wiring (considerPreconnect, the tap
activation) waits for the kept-entry model decision (seq 14381).
Build: noseam assembleDebug 4 ABI rc0, Kotlin unit 290/0.
